integration_assessment: Merge current main 1371532344e546f9b26b76b3f9ad25c90ede725d into the Scout line first, preserving both parents. Main contains all eight new commits from merged PRs #61 and #62.

Current main and Scout have disjoint changed-file sets from shared merge base 53581e9cbd2565e9e088c8fcd52fb1ba5c739b09. No source-file merge conflict is indicated by that comparison; a local merge has not been run by this audit.

The three robot branches form a chain, with Atlas containing Kestrel and Trident. Their head is not a replacement for Scout: Atlas lacks six later Scout commits. A correct integration must preserve the latest Scout fixes.

Atlas/Kestrel/Trident code touches shapes.ts and physics/hints.ts also changed by Scout; inspect merge semantics. These branches contain no new build guides or retained qualification receipts. Their test files are test definitions, not proof that tests passed.

Co-simulation is a separate runtime feature line from 0ee57d91be6f4f910f8b8d6106ba894b9b1a8d1d, with four commits outside Scout and two later Scout commits absent. It includes Trident and modifies simulation-controller/protocol/worker and physics/world. Requires focused runtime qualification before use.
Keep all original feature branch refs intact. Do not treat mechanical concepts or a passing file merge as verified printable real hardware.

integration_assessment: Requested Scout e10b5a586da28e5a68176c7989a0a17a3d278828 includes current main 6e8f065c6798cc4bfa1261f5c9413e69c4cbf367 and exact PR #1791 head fc333ddf88023cf17e9bb5973109b74a350f2ab7.

The three new model branches form Trident -> Kestrel -> Atlas. Atlas at 4f9ae64d4e22028a1a0439bcd704346ba0c14b1b is three commits beyond common base 7fbd4b5060fe22b0100adbf3e4725919ee0faeae but lacks five later Scout commits.

Their substantive additions are model-specific SB3 generator scripts/tests plus generated CAD SDK assets. Resolve generated SDK files by building from the final clean integrated CAD source and syncing, rather than selecting either stale bundle.

PR #1788 program qualification and #1731 Robot Lab R3/R4 are separate divergent lanes. Ancestry comparison does not prove whether individual fixes were cherry-picked; do not blindly merge the entire lanes as a CAD requirement.
PR #1785 is active MakeCode Arcade importer work unrelated to this robot design and should remain on its lane.
